name: Jumping-shrimp pancakes
summary: A small pancake, about a hand wide on the 6 October 2024 cẩm nang, and about a quarter of a southern bánh xèo on the food roundup. The batter is rice flour, not rice mixed with wheat. Roll it with rice paper and herbs. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Phu Yen. Du lịch Phú Yên’s 6 October 2024 cẩm nang and its food roundup both describe this pancake.
texture: The cẩm nang says the cake is about a hand wide, and that you eat several. The food roundup says the mould is about a quarter the size of a southern bánh xèo.
taste: The food roundup’s filling is bean sprouts and seafood, usually shrimp, sometimes squid. The batter is rice flour, mixed to the cook’s own formula, not rice flour plus wheat.
howToEat: Roll it in rice paper with herbs. The 6 October 2024 cẩm nang dips it in sweet-sour fish sauce or mắm nêm. Hours are Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Lê Duẩn and Chu Mạnh Trinh are the streets the 6 October 2024 cẩm nang gives.
seoTitle: Banh xeo tom nhay — a small Phu Yen pancake
seoDescription: A hand-wide pancake, about a quarter of a southern banh xeo, rolled with rice paper and herbs. Le Duan and Chu Manh Trinh. A price is Check on arrival.
